subject.title: Discord turns can be missed or finish silently across gateway restart/recovery on 2026.6.10

question: Should this issue remain open as the v2026.6.10 Discord restart/recovery incident until live proof splits or confirms the delivery, inbound catch-up, and cron recovery fixes, or should maintainers fold it into existing canonical trackers now?
rationale: The related trackers cover real slices, but the combined readiness and cron/task evidence is not fully owned by one merged fix or one canonical issue, and safe replay semantics need maintainer direction.

options.title: Keep as incident tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open, use the related open issues for slices, and require live Discord restart proof before closing the combined incident.

options.title: Close into existing trackers
options.body: Close this issue only if maintainers confirm the unique readiness and cron evidence is fully preserved by the existing open trackers.

options.title: Split one narrower follow-up
options.body: Create or nominate a narrower Discord restart proof issue for the remaining combined evidence, then close this issue as superseded.

recommendation.title: Keep as incident tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, use the related open issues for slices, and require live Discord restart proof before closing the combined incident.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses durable outbound delivery, Discord gateway/reconnect behavior, and channel recovery contract boundaries where their feature-history signal is strongest.
